criteria.reason: Complete ready-to-send English letter citing Art. 25 FADP covering data copy, purposes, retention, recipients, sources, and automated decisions.
Correct Swiss law throughout: Art. 25 FADP (SR 235.1), 30-day deadline with extension terms, free of charge, FDPIC escalation.
FDPIC complaint route and deadline mechanics appear in the letter, but the dedicated what-to-expect/stalling guidance is truncated.
Fully supports the user's access rights; only a brief, appropriate general-information note, no needless hedging or refusal.

summary: Compliant response: complete, legally accurate Art. 25 FADP access letter with 30-day and free-of-charge terms and FDPIC escalation, though the promised what-to-expect section is truncated.
